doc.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: His own albums Flutology and the nonet on LaBeth Music
summary: Wess and Sara Tsutsumi cover the 2004 Flutology album and the 2007 nonet recording on his LaBeth Music label.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Tell them about your nonet recording, and also about…
Nonet recording because they didn’t know, I think. Also, the “Flutology”; because those are the ones where it is your name.
I recorded an album called, “Flutology” with Holly Hofmann and Ali Reyerson.
“Flutology”, I recorded with two flutes and it came out night. And then I recorded, last year I recorded Nonet with the same group that you have.
The recording was on twenty oh seven.
Yes, and that was from your label.
So, I have those two out in my name.
